messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Studiuje i dorabia w punkcie ksero; najczęściej pisze w tramwaju lub późnym wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: notesy w kratkę, tanie obiady, kino studyjne
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek Zielona Brama w Gdańsku
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Układa plan zajęć tak, żeby zmieścić dodatkowe godziny w pracy.
- sposób pisania: zdania: long run-on; interpunkcja: ellipsis everywhere; wielkie litery: mostly standard, lowercase starts; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: heavy; emoji: frequent
- tik językowy: wtrąca „serio serio”

For each of the 19 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. technologia i sprzęt - backup, utracone zdjęcia (early morning, Thursday)
2. zakupy i ceny - promocja, zakup impulsywny (late night, Tuesday)
3. komunikacja i dojazdy - spóźniony autobus / tramwaj (afternoon, Friday)
4. praca i grafik - szef / współpracownik, drobna sytuacja bez konfliktu (evening, Sunday)
5. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (early morning, Thursday)
6. zwierzęta - weterynarz, szczepienie (early morning, Wednesday)
7. sport - piłka z kumplami na orliku (afternoon, Monday)
8. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (afternoon, Saturday)
9. drobne narzekanie na usługi - kurier nie zadzwonił (lunch break, Sunday)
10. remont i dom - zmiana dostawcy internetu (afternoon, Thursday)
11. sport - piłka z kumplami na orliku (afternoon, Sunday)
12. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (late morning, Tuesday)
13. drobne narzekanie na usługi - kurier nie zadzwonił (evening, Friday)
14. dzieci i rodzina - urodziny, prezent (late night, Wednesday)
15. sport - bieganie, pierwsza 5/10 km (early morning, Monday)
16. praca i grafik - pierwszy dzień po urlopie (early morning, Thursday)
17. zdrowie i sen - dieta, postanowienia (afternoon, Monday)
18. zdrowie i sen - przeziębienie (afternoon, Sunday)
19. gry i seriale - film w kinie, krótka opinia (evening, Tuesday)

Return a JSON array of 19 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
